title: Jellyfish wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bell' cx='50%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3e6'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e056c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a0248f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tent' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9be0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c93fb0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M30 55 q-6 10 2 18 q6 7 -1 16' fill='none' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M41 58 q-5 9 1 17 q5 7 -1 15' fill='none' stroke='#e86fd0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 59 q4 9 -1 17 q-5 7 1 15' fill='none' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 57 q5 9 -1 17 q-6 7 0 16' fill='none' stroke='#e86fd0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 53 q6 10 -2 18 q-6 7 2 15' fill='none' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bell -->
  <path d='M18 52 q0 -34 32 -34 q32 0 32 34 q-16 8 -32 8 q-16 0 -32 -8 z' fill='url(#bell)'/>
  <!-- bell inner glow highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#ffd0f2' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <path d='M24 38 h22 q3 0 3 3 q0 9 -14 9 q-14 0 -14 -9 q0 -3 3 -3 z' fill='#2b1b4d' stroke='#8f6fe0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M54 38 h22 q3 0 3 3 q0 9 -14 9 q-14 0 -14 -9 q0 -3 3 -3 z' fill='#2b1b4d' stroke='#8f6fe0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='47' y='40' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8f6fe0'/>
  <rect x='20' y='39' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8f6fe0'/>
  <rect x='75' y='39' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8f6fe0'/>
  <!-- lens glare -->
  <path d='M29 41 l6 0 l-4 7 l-5 0 z' fill='#c9b6ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M59 41 l6 0 l-4 7 l-5 0 z' fill='#c9b6ff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M45 51 q5 5 10 0' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0f2' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
